I saved the draft mail to Tobias and confirmed it to June in her DM. Nothing has been sent yet; someone still needs to send the draft.

- To: Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com, an internal address, so Ruth's approval isn't needed).
- Subject: "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate for planning sheet".
- Body: the proposed 2027 rate of $1,313 a seat, as Pree gave it. It says June approved sharing it and asks Tobias to keep it internal and treat it as proposed, not signed.

Two things to know:
- June can approve this herself because she runs the deal desk. Under the finance-figures rule, either she or Anselm can approve sending a rate to someone who doesn't own the account.
- The $1,313 figure comes only from June's message. On our records I could only find the 2026 order form ($1,850 gross a seat with a 14% discount), so I couldn't check $1,313 against anything.
